content: विकिरः .²1 A scattered portion or fallen bit. .²2 One who tears or scatters, a bird; कङ्कोलीफलजग्धिमुग्धविकिरव्याहारिणस्तद्भुवो भागाः <ls>Māl. 6. 19</ls>. .²3 A well. .²4 A tree. .²5 A scattered portion of rice (offered to hostile beings in a sacrifice); उच्छिष्टं भागधेयं स्याद्दर्भेषु विकिरश्च यः <ls>Ms. 3. 245</ls>. .²6 Water trickled through; <ls>Suśr.</ls>
